$comment: Routes the app serves that no interaction reaches, each naming the feature that will reach it. `scripts/verify-reachability.mjs` fails on an orphan that is NOT listed here, AND on a listing that IS reachable or whose feature is already done — both directions, because a dead exemption is how a live one gets waved through later. Same shape and same reason as unreached-tokens.json (ADR-0088). THE WHOLE LIST PRINTS ON EVERY RUN: an exemption nobody reads is an exemption nobody weighs.
$readingComment: This file is the answer to "are you sure you have added all pages, and links". Eight finished screens — each with a conformance subject, accessibility coverage and tests — that a person holding the phone could not open. If it grows without shrinking, that is the thing to notice.

unreachable.why: The calibrated measurement path. The Profile tab opens straight into setup and offers nothing else.

FR-58's export and deletion — the screen that makes the on-device privacy claim actionable rather than merely true. Being unreachable is worse here than elsewhere: a person cannot exercise a right they cannot find.
FR-33's outfit builder. The Wardrobe offers adding a garment and nothing to do with the garments once added.
FR-52's shopping check — three measurements about a garment somebody has not bought. F-199 later gives a colour combination a way into it, which only works if the screen can be opened at all.
